We learned significant figures first, then powers of 10 and calculator entry, followed by scientific notation, engineering notation, and metric prefixes.

Grob calls the related textbook material **Introduction to Powers of 10**. Its concise summary and definitions are the reference for the powers-of-10 lessons here. [[1, pp. 2–17]](../../references.qmd#ref-grob2016)
